rules.statement: A writ of mandamus cannot be granted to undo an act already done, nor will the court allow the validity of an act purportedly done under a statute to be tried in an action for mandamus.
rules.supporting_quote: "The writ of mandamus is most beneficial; but we must keep its operation within legal bounds, and not grant it at the fancy of all mankind. We grant it when that has not been done which a statute orders to be done; but not for the purpose of undoing what has been done."
